name: Bishop DeLavey
summary: In Stormwind Keep, Bishop DeLavey hears the court's quiet concerns. He represents the Church of the Holy Light in the Petitioner's Chamber, where matters of faith and state meet.

sections.title: A Bishop at Court
sections.body: Bishop DeLavey advises Stormwind's court from within the keep. While Archbishop Benedictus tends to the Cathedral of Light, DeLavey lives among the nobility and petitioners. He brings spiritual counsel to the court while reckoning with the kingdom's politics. His place there lets him hear whispered rumors and delicate grievances before they reach Highlord Bolvar Fordragon or the young King Anduin.

sections.title: A Delicate Inquiry
sections.body: A missing diplomat has drawn Bishop DeLavey into a secret inquiry. The diplomat was sent to meet Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore but never arrived. To prevent panic, the court keeps the disappearance quiet. Suspecting the Defias Brotherhood, DeLavey goes around the usual guard channels. He uses private contacts and discreet adventurers, including the fisherman Jorgen, to reach hidden informants such as Elling Trias.

faq.q: Where can Bishop DeLavey be found?
faq.answer: Bishop DeLavey is in the Petitioner's Chamber inside Stormwind Keep, just off the main entryway where subjects gather to petition the royal court.

faq.q: What is his role in Stormwind Keep?
faq.answer: Bishop DeLavey represents the Church of the Holy Light at Stormwind's royal court. He handles church affairs, advises the nobility, and quietly takes up sensitive matters for the kingdom.

faq.q: Why is he investigating the missing diplomat?
aliases: why does delavey care about the diplomat
faq.answer: The diplomat vanished while traveling to meet Lady Jaina Proudmoore in Theramore. Bishop DeLavey suspects Defias interference and investigates through trusted channels to keep the crisis from alarming the public.

faq.q: How is DeLavey connected to Elling Trias?
faq.answer: Bishop DeLavey passes messages through intermediaries, including the fisherman Jorgen, to Elling Trias, a master of cheese who secretly gathers intelligence for SI:7.

angles.text: As a priest, DeLavey shows how closely the Church of the Holy Light is involved in Stormwind's politics, where faith meets statecraft and covert affairs.
As an Alliance member, you can see DeLavey's discreet inquiry at work to protect the fragile peace between Stormwind and Lady Jaina Proudmoore's outpost of Theramore.
